title: Worlds Weather and Climate
learning_objectives: Explain the difference between weather and climate.
Identify and describe the factors affecting climate.
Understand the different types of climate found in the world.
Recognize the climatic zones of the Earth.
Explain how climate affects human life and the environment.

production_scope.description: Opening through Word Bank, original PDF pages 1-7.

approval.evidence: User requested remaining chapters sequentially and explicitly requested Chapter 3 generation on 2026-10-06.
